description: This file defines the EmailSubscriptionDao class responsible for data access operations related to email subscriptions in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, counting, and saving email notification entities, utilizing query builders and paginator abstractions.

classes.name: EmailSubscriptionDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for managing email subscription data, providing methods for CRUD operations and retrieval with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of EmailNotification objects based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriptionList
methods.description: Returns a paginator for email notifications matching the filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriptionListCount
methods.description: Returns the count of email subscriptions matching the filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriptionById
methods.description: Fetches a specific EmailNotification by its ID, returns null if not found.

methods.name: saveEmailSubscription
methods.description: Persists a given EmailNotification entity to the database.
